question: How can a weak yet shining awareness remove obstacles by uniting twofold experience?
premises: Even what is weak can gain strength.
It shines as one state within twofold experience.
In that condition it removes obstacles.
inference: Awareness, though initially weak, becomes effective when it shines as a unified ground of dual experience.
uncertainties: The exact object removed by haranty is unstated.
plain_english: Even when weak, once it has gained strength and shines as a single state within twofold experience, it removes them.
